claims.original_statement: Zero-endpoint endomorphisms of one distinguished triangle have pairwise zero product; five Hom-vanishing conditions guarantee uniqueness.
claims.proved_statement: For any two distinguished triangles, middle components with zero endpoints form the explicit intersection of two factorization-image subgroups. These groups form a square-zero ideal across all distinguished triangles. Completion sets are torsors for these groups, with the stated exact inverse formula.
